observations: Two large cardboard boxes stacked on top of each other.
The boxes are labeled 'Hisense' and 'CHEST FREEZER'.
A white sticker on the right side of the boxes displays the model 'FC-91DD'.
The boxes are secured with factory-style white plastic strapping.
The text 'Hisense Corporation' is visible at the bottom of the boxes.
There is a watermark 'SIR J ELECTRONICS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' across the center.

claims.evidence: This is a request for contact, not a verifiable claim about the item's condition.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the freezer outside the box with the door open.

risks.risk: The unit inside may be non-functional or have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in, powered on, and the interior cooling.

risks.risk: The item may be a used or refurbished unit repacked in an original box.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the interior, door seals, and the manufacturer's plate on the back of the unit.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual freezer outside of the box.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the back of the unit.
Video showing the unit powered on and the interior cooling.
Photo of the interior of the freezer showing the baskets and walls.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identifiable from the packaging. The item is priced at its worst-case scenario (unverified contents and non-functional) until proof of the actual unit and its condition is provided.
